title: Include stalled pipeline handoffs in manager check-ins
description: Report current wait reason, waiting party, elapsed time and significant pipeline stalls alongside task anomalies. Managers inspect their direct reports and flow coordinators; do not repeatedly ping idle agents or automatically approve/resume blocked work.
acceptanceCriteria: Stalled deliverable alerts identify exact stage and responsible waiting party
Repeated observations deduplicate and legitimate idle/approval waits remain explicit
Manager check-ins do not create another queue or bypass owner approvals
